MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 2/2

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 46
   B. 30
   C. 23
   D. 120

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 88
   B. 19
   C. 22
   D. 38

4. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

5. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

6. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 25

7. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 50
   C. 11
   D. 100

8. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 1

9. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

10. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

11. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

12. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

13. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

14. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 29

15. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

16. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
